source.function: computeFactorMatrix (scripts/research/factors.ts:1291) with style 'scalping', column raw.rsi; then monthlyThresholds (scripts/research/snipe-tails.ts:70)

params.lookbackDays_note: shrunk from the production 90: a 90-day lookback needs about 26k 5m bars, which cannot stay under 300 KB. The port must take lookback as a parameter.
params.ohlcv_rule: open = previous close (own c at i=0), high = c*1.001, low = c*0.999, volume = 1000 + (i%13)*10, tbv null (this fixture uses o = previous close, h = c*1.001, l = c*0.999)

notes: The 5m series is built from separate runs with gaps between them (the matrix and monthlyThresholds see array positions and timestamps as given). RSI is rounded by the indicator (2 decimals). Missing rows between runs are spanned by the indicator.

blocks.block: first month: series starts 2 days before April, so March has no full lookback (A1-2)
April normal: window rows 288 (full) all after warm-up
May: window rows 100 (< 144, half-window rule fails)
July: flat prices, constant RSI over a full window, p10 == p90
September: window rows exactly 200 (minValues edge, passes)

cases.first_month_no_lookback: month 2024-03 thresholds null (series starts 2024-03-30, inside the lookback)
cases.p10_ge_p90: 2024-07: flat prices, constant RSI, thresholds equal
